note: Boxes are [west, south, east, north] in degrees. Each region's archives are written under out/master/ at the paths below; shared/src/simRegionsBuild.test.ts holds them equal to the archive paths shared/src/simRegions.ts declares.

heights.name: Simulated New Zealand heights
heights.credit: Elevation: simulated data for New Zealand, not a real survey. Heights are New Zealand LiDAR 1 m DEM, © Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (CC BY 4.0), where that survey covers, and COPERNICUS GLO-30 (30 m; © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved) elsewhere in the box. Cut from Mapterhorn.

heights.name: Simulated Utah heights
heights.credit: Elevation: simulated data for Utah, not a real survey. Heights are the U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program 1 m DEMs (public domain, U.S. Government work) where that survey covers, and COPERNICUS GLO-30 (30 m; © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved) elsewhere in the box. Cut from Mapterhorn.

heights.name: Simulated worldwide heights
heights.credit: Elevation: simulated data for the world, not a real survey. Heights are Mapterhorn's worldwide tiles, which are COPERNICUS GLO-30 (30 m; © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved) merged with finer surveys where they exist, here New Zealand LiDAR (© Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand, CC BY 4.0) and the U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (public domain).
